Written by the people who lodge them

Resources

What you can claim, what changed this year, and what the ATO actually does with the answer. Written by the people who prepare the returns, and updated when the rules move — which is every 1 July.

  • Start here

    The $1,000 standard deduction: what it is and who it helps

    From 1 July 2026 every Australian taxpayer can claim $1,000 of work-related expenses without receipts. Here is how it works and when itemising still beats it.

    Updated 21 Aug 2026

  • Start here

    What can I claim on tax?

    A plain guide to work-related tax deductions in Australia: what qualifies, what does not, what records you need, and what each claim is actually worth.

    Updated 21 Aug 2026

Free tools

Built by us, free to use, no sign-up and no email address. Everything you enter stays in your own browser.

  • What people in your job claim

    Average work-related deductions for 40 occupations, from the ATO’s own tax statistics. Find your job and see how your claim compares.

  • Tax invoice generator

    Build a compliant tax invoice and save it as a PDF. Checks it carries everything the ATO requires.

  • Vehicle logbook

    Log trips, track the 12-week period, and see whether the logbook method beats cents per kilometre.

  • All calculators

    Eleven calculators covering refunds, income tax, GST, HECS-HELP, CGT, crypto and rental property.

Rates, dates and getting set up

The reference pages people come back to every year, and the first steps before any return can be lodged.

  • Australian tax rates

    Resident, foreign resident and working holiday maker rates, year by year.

  • Tax return deadline

    31 October if you lodge yourself, and how the agent lodgement program changes it.

  • How to apply for a tax file number

    Which of the ATO’s application routes applies to you, what ID you need, and how long it takes.

  • BAS: monthly, quarterly or annually?

    How often you report GST and PAYG withholding, and the due dates that follow.

  • Motor vehicle deductions for sole traders

    Cents per kilometre or logbook, the records each needs, and when to switch.

More guides

  • What can I claim on tax without receipts?

    The $300 rule, the claims that never need receipts, and the $1,000 standard deduction from 2026-27. What you can substantiate without a shoebox of paper.

  • Working from home tax deductions

    The fixed rate and actual cost methods for home office deductions, what records the ATO now requires, and which method leaves you better off.

  • How to lodge your tax return

    The three ways to lodge an Australian tax return, what you need before you start, when to wait for pre-fill, and how the agent deadline extension works.

  • Do I need to lodge a tax return?

    When you must lodge an Australian tax return, when you can submit a non-lodgement advice instead, and why lodging is usually worth it even when you do not have to.

Deductions by occupation

Deductions cluster hard by what you do. These cover the claims your occupation actually gets, and the ones it most often gets wrong.

    6 deduction categories, and what to avoid.

    6 deduction categories, and what to avoid.

    5 deduction categories, and what to avoid.

    6 deduction categories, and what to avoid.

Prefer a number to an article?

Every calculator on this site is free and ungated. Most questions people bring to a guide are answered faster by typing an income into a tool.
